subject.title: Proof stack for generated media wake-false fallback

question: Should this draft remain a proof-only combined target until visible Telegram proof succeeds, or should maintainers accept another proof/landing boundary for the generated-media wake-false work?
rationale: The code shape appears plausible, but the PR intentionally stacks two open merge boundaries and the available Mantis run did not actually exercise the visible baseline/candidate media behavior.

options.title: Keep Proof-Only And Require Live Proof
options.body: Keep this draft open and non-landing until a redacted Telegram Desktop artifact, terminal live output, or logs show main missing or blocking the marker image and the candidate delivering exactly one image.

options.title: Accept Internal Proof Instead
options.body: Maintainers may decide scheduler-level or non-visible Mantis evidence is enough and then land the split implementation and harness with the remaining visible-proof uncertainty explicitly owned.

options.title: Retire The Stack
options.body: Close this draft once it has served its proof purpose or if the proof runner cannot exercise the scenario, while preserving the split PRs as the actionable work.

recommendation.title: Keep Proof-Only And Require Live Proof
recommendation.body: Keep this draft open and non-landing until a redacted Telegram Desktop artifact, terminal live output, or logs show main missing or blocking the marker image and the candidate delivering exactly one image.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision primarily concerns the Telegram/Mantis proof harness and proof sufficiency path, where recent history points to this handle.
